confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on aggregator snapshots (Numbeo May 2026, Expatica June 2026, Expatistan and 2026 guides), which are partly crowd-sourced, so they are medium quality. Cocktail uses a 2025 DesignMyNight average, and wine_glass uses an ONS January 2025 175ml average uplifted for restaurant pricing, so both are weaker. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July in Cardiff and were not checked against live listings. GBP amounts were converted to USD at an assumed 1.30 USD per GBP that I did not source from this search. The FX value of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 came from a third-party aggregator (ozfinancehub.com.au) that presents it as RBA data; I did not verify it on rba.gov.au. A same-day Trading Economics quote of 0.6715 is consistent with it. The source_url is the RBA exchange rates page that should be checked against this value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cardiff restaurant and drink anchors are based on Cardiff-specific aggregated figures, cross-checked against each other. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from the UK on-trade price relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on comparable UK regional cities such as Bristol and Birmingham, adjusted for July demand.
